{'content': 'Last month, OpenAI previewed a piece of hardware under the Codex brand. Today, the company officially launched its collaboration with Work Louder — the Codex Micro keyboard, priced at $230.'}

{'content': 'Here is the product introduction:'}

{'content': 'The keyboard comes in two versions: a tactile clicky (blue switch, audible) version and a silent version.'}

{'content': 'According to the website description: “Each Agent key lights up with RGB effects based on Codex’s real-time status, so you can tell at a glance whether it’s thinking, executing, waiting, or done — before switching conversations.”'}

{'content': 'The product page also lists three Codex-exclusive features:'}

  • {'content': 'Instant Trigger Skills: Flip a joystick to launch common Codex workflows such as reviewing PRs (Pull Requests), debugging, or refactoring code.'}
  • {'content': 'Core Operations at Your Fingertips: The command key provides dedicated shortcuts for the most common actions, including accept, reject, talk, new conversation, and more. Less switching, faster delivery.'}
  • {'content': 'Adjustable Computing Power on the Fly: Turn the knob to instantly adjust the reasoning level. Keep it fast for simple tasks, and crank it up when deep thinking is required.'}
